Everyone on Stone (6 Villagers & a Prelate) Build TC;
on Stone if going 3 TC, Gold if only 2, once TC's are complete inspire (8) Villagers on Gold;

research siege and push with MAA/Landshits Make Rams just outside their LOS, when you push leave (1) MAA building rams;
